<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope (M, M+1 ≈14 %, M+2 ≈1 %, M+3 ≈0.07 %, etc.) and the ~1.003 Da spacing, the pattern matches the 13C isotopic distribution expected for a molecule containing multiple carbon atoms. No other common element shows this characteristic pattern at the observed intensities, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
